material.acceptance_criteria: At 375 by 667, a visible control reachable by touch moves the camera (the minimap or an equivalent button), and its purpose is stated in visible text rather than a hover title. Close stale only with a live check at that size showing such a control.
material.description: js/client/play.html:143 sets #ui-bar-right { display: none; } inside @media (max-width: 600px), and the minimap canvas sits in #ui-bar-right (play.html:172). The minimap click is the only camera control visible in the HUD scope: it sends camera_to (scenarios/moba/controls.lua:561-562). codesearch 'camera' literal over js/client/widgets.js and scenarios/moba/panels.lua returned no match, so no on-screen panel button moves the camera. Keyboard Space recentres on the hero (controls.lua:280) and right-drag orbits (controls.lua:471); neither is visible on a touch phone. The only explanation of the minimap is a hover title (js/client/hud.js:44), which touch users never see. Principle: Krug, first-use obviousness. Evidence: codesearch regex 'ui-bar-right|#minimap' over js/client/play.html (dispatch 1792858468954-4522-877e452dde641de6); codesearch 'camera_to|camera' over scenarios/moba/controls.lua (dispatch 1792858452267-4476-2d3f376ac4925d8). Related but distinct: device-phone-layout-overlap-375 covers panel overlap, not the hidden camera control. Caveat: stale_tree as above.
material.subject: On phones the minimap, the only visible camera control in the HUD, is hidden at 600px and below
material.witness: Live Pages at 375x667: #centre-hero 'Centre on hero' display block, 150x21 in viewport, elementFromPoint at centre is the button; #ui-bar-right display none. At 1280x720 minimap flex and centre-hero visible. Click-to-camera_to is the handler at hud.js:66-72 on tip, not clicked live (no match). Fix 4ee45ed6 on origin tip. CI on tip 7f68d3bcc7c7356b1291ccec7eda0b23ad2a89f2 green (ci-status 6/6 success, run 40128978828).
material.witness_plan: fs_read play.html media block on upstream tip; codesearch camera_to over js/client and scenarios/moba after reconciling; live check at 375x667 that a camera control is visible and activates camera_to.
